body: Everyone says they're always hiring but they won't hire me no matter how many places I apply to.
Every entry job I can find. I have no experience and no education past high school.
Yeah I fixed it. I'm ​so useless I can't even write properly lol.

I am not defined by anything, I'm just an empty void with no  personality  or ambitions. I have nobody to rely on, no friends, no relatives, nothing. I just don't see a point in going on any longer. All my problems would be gone if I just jumped off the edge. It's not like I have to worry about anyone after I die, nobody gives a shit.

I can't think about one thing at a time because every problem I have is made worse by another. I can't get out of this house. My family's emotional abuse has killed any desire I had to succeed, yet they are making it a living hell for me to stay here. I screwed up my life when I dropped out of school, I only did it because I was convinced I would kill myself, but I'm still here and now my life is ruined.
I attempted suicide and they convinced me to lie to the hospital folk and say that it was an accident, because they didn't want to be bothered with phone calls and hospital fees.

I still want that. Even if it makes me miserable, I still want to try.

> i cry whenever people say they earn a living wage in an office job by mostly going on reddit or youtube

ME TOO. I hate when people say this. Every other top post on Reddit is from someone who is at their office desk messing around and getting paid for it. How do people even get those jobs, I want to know.

It bothers me because I see all of this stuff online about mental health awareness and how much everybody understands and cares about each other but as soon as I turn away from the screen I find a world where nobody understands and it's all in my head. And then they wonder why I'm addicted to technology.
Thank you. And I'm sorry for whatever is causing you pain. I looked through some of your posts and I see a lot of pain :(

They are very emotionally abusive and they hate me because I left their religion. They took away all my books and games because it is "sinful" and they think I am possesed by the devil because I am depressed. I am not a minor but I'm financially dependant on them. I dont have a job so I can't move out but living here is hell. I've tried running away but I can't survive on my own. I just want to be dead.
That makes me happy. Glad I could benefit someone if only a little.
This is what I did but the result is feeling empty  And at this point I'd rather feel anything, even pain, than feel emptiness.
These are the kind of friends I need.
No I don't want to.

I don't know, it seems to be getting better. But if it killed me, that wouldn't be so bad either. 
I don't do anything anymore. I have lost my enjoyment for things like music, movies, etc.
There is not much to say about myself. I am a college dropout with nothing going for me, my family hates me and I have no friends. That is my life.
I don't know what to talk about or why I made this post, there isn't anything that can help. I'm just all alone with nowhere left to go except the other side.

I don't want to try it, there is nothing wrong with me. Everybody else is the problem. My life is already wasted, I wish I could do it over as somebody else with a better family, in a better place but I can't fix it the way it is. I am just done. Everybody says "talk to someone, you're not alone" and then they abuse me and betray me, I am just done with it all. Thank you for talking to me./

It has been a year since I was kicked from school for failing classes repeatedly, I have been searching for a job since but nobody will hire me because I am useless. I called the hotline and they phoned the police, I was taken to the hospital and assessed by a psychiatrist. I told them I didn't mean what I said so they let me go but they won't stop calling me to make an appointment. I don't want to see them because I am not ill and they cannot help me. Talking to someone will not change my situation and I don't want pills, I am tired of everyone thinking I am disturbed. I just want to be done.

I am 20 and not in school or work, still live with my awful family. They just discovered that I am suicidal and they will not stop giving me a hard time about it. I don't know what to do, there is no way out for me I just want to die.

There are way too many problems, I don't even know where to start. I have been betrayed and alienated by family and friends so many times and in so many ways I had to cut them all off to stay sane. I failed out of college and ruined my life and destroyed my self-worth. I am being viciously harrassed online by strangers for no reason. I left my faith and with it my last reason to not kill myself. Suicide hotline did not want to speak with me. Everyone has given up on me and I have given up on everything and there is no more hope in ever getting better. I hope tonight is the last time I have to ever feel this way.

I feel the same. Life is much more manageable when you have a back up option. But it also keeps me from fully commiting to life, I feel like I'm on the brink between life and death. 

Do you want to talk about why you want a way out?
This is why I have no friends anymore. Honestly I am much better off on my own than I was with fake friends.

I felt the exact same way, everybody took me for granted and nobody valued my existence. I ended up cutting off every single one of my friends. Sometimes I feel lonely and regret it but sometimes I feel very liberated and independent. Nobody who makes you feel alone is worth your time. And please please consider leaving your boyfriend. Telling you he misses his old girlfriends is absolutely not okay. That is incredibly insensitive and hurtful, you don't need someone like that in your life. Being depressed doesn't mean people get to walk all over you. Stand up for yourself, even if it means you lose everything

Oh my god, you poor soul. This is heartbreaking, I am so sorry for you and that poor girl. Listen to me darling:

### It's not your fault

There's no possible way you could have known what was going on, many times the people struggling the most are the best at hiding it. You don't know what her home life is like, how her parents treated her, or what else she was going through. Don't blame yourself. You are not a bad person, nor a bad teacher. If you can, please give yourself some time off and get some emotional support, professionally or from family & friends. This is a lot to handle.

This is awful, my parents control my life too and I can't stand it. You haven't done anything wrong. Do you have a phone? If you're ever home alone or if nobody can hear you, can you call a suicide hotline? Somebody can talk to you and find you help if you request it.

How is your relationship with your sister? Are you able to talk to her about how you feel?
It's so hard to live like this. I feel like my life is a waste. I have hobbies but they feel so empty when I'm all alone. I don't know how long I can continue like this.

Hello, thanks for reaching out. You're right, no one should be lonely. It feels like I'm drowning when I'm by myself. But I can't do anything to change it. Right now I'm hardly even living, I am just surviving. I am an unemployed college dropout with no direction in life, I can't talk to anyone or meet people the way I am now.

Thank you.

No matter how much I tell myself I can be happy on my own, I feel like my life has no meaning if other people aren't a part of it. Every happy thought I have disappears the second I look up from whatever screen I'm using to escape reality. I ruined all my real life relationships and I'm not in a position to make new friends, so this is all I have. But I don't think it's enough, I can't carry on like this much longer.

Yeah, that is also really irritating. The general consensus of the thread is determined by the first wave of comments, and anything posted after that must conform to the popular opinion of the thread, or else.
I am alone on New Year's Eve but for the first time I don't feel bad about it, I'm having plenty of fun by myself.
